# EvoScientist v0.1.1 — DeltaChannel Upgrade, Tier-Aware Skill Mounts, Status & Elapsed Time, QQ Inline Buttons

G'Day! v0.1.1 is a focused follow-up to the v0.1.0 async-sub-agent release. The headline is the **deepagents 0.5.7 → 0.6.2 upgrade**, which moves message storage to LangGraph 1.2's **DeltaChannel** and required a careful rewrite of our resume path so `/resume` no longer shows "0 messages". The upgrade also enables the new **CodeInterpreterMiddleware** with a research-tuned PTC allowlist, so the supervisor can `Promise.all` over `start_async_task` and fan out experiments / writing / data-analysis without per-dispatch round-trips. We also ship a **tier-aware virtual mount resolver** that finally lets shell `execute` see globally-installed skills (paper-navigator, nano-banana, experiment-iterative-coder all work in shell now), a **status bar phase + elapsed-time indicator**, **inline keyboard buttons for QQ Bot HITL prompts**, a new **`dashscope-code` provider** for Alibaba Bailian Coding Plan keys, and a fix for `@file` mentions on paths with spaces.

---

### 🧩 deepagents 0.6.2 + DeltaChannel — `/resume` Reconstruction Rewrite

LangGraph 1.2 (pulled in by deepagents 0.6) changes how message history is persisted. Previously every super-step wrote a full `channel_values` snapshot; now it writes incremental `_DeltaSnapshot` / `Overwrite` records into the `writes` table and only seeds an occasional snapshot in `checkpoints`. EvoSci's `/resume`, `/threads`, status-bar message count, and channel-UI thread display all read from `channel_values` only, so under 0.6 every restored thread showed **"0 messages"** even when the DB had hundreds (#231).

**Reproduced** with thread `c5c8ac6f`: 78 user messages in DB → displayed as 0 before fix → all 78 reconstruct correctly after.

- **`_load_checkpoint_messages` rewrite** — walks both `checkpoints` (for `_DeltaSnapshot` seeds) and `writes` (for incremental deltas) in chronological order, applies `_messages_delta_reducer` from deepagents. Handles three message-storage shapes: bare list, `_DeltaSnapshot.value`, and `Overwrite.value` (reset semantics). Fail-closed fallback when reducer unavailable.
- **Retention bumped** — `checkpoint_keep_per_thread` default `10` → `1000`. The old value was sized for snapshot checkpoints; under DeltaChannel each turn writes many small per-channel records, so 10 truncated mid-thread within minutes. Truncation detection logs a warning when pruning has clipped historical messages.
- **Test fixture fix** — `tests/test_sessions.py` schema corrected (`blob BLOB` → `value BLOB`) to match `langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite`'s actual `writes` table column.

#### CodeInterpreterMiddleware (langchain-quickjs)

New `EvoScientist/middleware/code_interpreter.py` integrates deepagents 0.6's `CodeInterpreterMiddleware` with a research-tuned **PTC (Programmatic Tool Calling) allowlist**. The LLM can write a small JavaScript snippet that calls allowed tools and `Promise.all`s the results, instead of emitting N sequential tool calls.

- **Allowlist (11 read-only / batchable tools)**: `tavily_search`, `task`, `start_async_task` / `check_async_task` / `update_async_task` / `cancel_async_task` / `list_async_tasks`, `read_file`, `grep`, `glob`, `ls`.
- **Explicitly excluded**: `execute` (would bypass HITL approval), `write_file` / `edit_file` (side-effectful), `think_tool` (not batchable).
- **Killer use case**: `Promise.all([start_async_task(...), start_async_task(...), start_async_task(...)])` fans out three writing / data-analysis sub-agents in one turn. Under v0.1.0 this took three round-trips.

**Dependency bump**: `deepagents>=0.5.7` → `deepagents[quickjs]>=0.6.1` (pulls langchain 1.3, langgraph 1.2, langchain-quickjs 0.1.2).

---

### 📂 Tier-Aware Virtual Mount Resolution for Shell `execute`

Globally-installed skills that ship executable scripts (`paper-navigator`, `nano-banana`, `experiment-iterative-coder`, …) silently broke when invoked from `execute`: file tools (`read_file`, `glob`) could see them via `MergedSkillsBackend`, but shell commands rewrote `/skills/foo` to `./foo` (workspace-relative) and got `No such file or directory` (#236, closes #235).

**Root cause**: `convert_virtual_paths_in_command` rewrote every `/foo` token to `./foo` with no awareness of `CompositeBackend`'s registered virtual mounts. Likely regression from when `install_skill()` defaulted to `global_install=True` — the install path moved to the global tier but the shell rewrite stayed workspace-only.

- **`_resolve_virtual_mount_path(token)`** — walks tier priority (`USER → GLOBAL → BUILTIN`) for `/skills/...`, substitutes `MEMORIES_DIR` for `/memories/...`, returns `None` for non-mount tokens. Fallback target is `USER_SKILLS_DIR` (matches `MergedSkillsBackend.write`'s primary tier so shell errors name a sensible location).
- **`validate_command` / `_extract_all_paths`** gain an `allow_prefixes` kwarg with directory-boundary-aware matching via new `_is_under_allowed_prefix` — guards against the `/A/skills` vs `/A/skills_evil` overmatch bypass, plus empty / root-only prefix admission.
- **`CustomSandboxBackend.execute`** threads `(USER_SKILLS_DIR, GLOBAL_SKILLS_DIR, MEMORIES_DIR, _BUILTIN_SKILLS_DIR)` into the allowlist so resolver-injected absolute paths aren't blocked by the system-path checker.
- **14 new tests** in `TestVirtualMountResolution`: tier priority (workspace > global > builtin), tier fallback, `/memories/` substitution, bare-mount resolution, `/skillset/...` overmatch guard, allowlist boundary semantics, plus two end-to-end `CustomSandboxBackend.execute` checks for workspace-tier and global-tier skills.

**Out of scope**: paths inside quoted `python -c "..."` strings (pre-existing regex limitation, tracked separately).

---

### ⏱️ Status Bar Phase + Elapsed Time Indicator

The status bar now shows the **current phase** (`idle` / `thinking` / `researching` / `writing` / `done`) with elapsed time, and the post-turn token usage widget includes per-turn duration (#218 by @mooshroom4422, closes #173).

```
 writing... (1m 23s)              [Usage: 12.4k in · 1.8k out · 2m 07s]
```

- Real-time phase-driven status updates instead of a generic spinner.
- "Writing" phase gets a distinct hint color so long generations don't blend into the background.
- Elapsed time included in `UsageWidget` next to token counts — useful for spotting outlier turns.

---

### 🔘 QQ Bot HITL — Inline Keyboard Buttons (C2C)

QQ Bot HITL approval prompts in C2C (one-to-one) chats now render native **inline keyboard buttons** — tap **Approve / Reject / Approve all** instead of typing `1` / `2` / `3` (#220 by @MuXinCG2004).

- **End-to-end `inline_buttons` capability** — wired through bus consumer + CLI HITL prompt, so any future channel that advertises the capability will auto-attach Approve / Reject / Approve-all buttons.
- **Generic `{text, value, type}` shape** mapped to QQ's `{render_data, action}` payload via `_build_qq_keyboard`. Single coercion point handles non-string `value`s.
- **Tap = same code path as typing `1`/`2`/`3`** — buttons whose `value` matches `_parse_approval_reply` flow through the same resolver, so backward compat with typed replies is preserved.
- **Follow-up confirmation message** (`✅ 已批准` / `❌ 已拒绝`) sent after the user resolves the prompt — QQ has no message-edit / recall API for C2C, so a fresh message is the only way to give the click visible feedback.
- **Silent on timeout** — auto-reject after 2 min doesn't send `❌ 已拒绝`, avoiding the impression that the user actively rejected when they walked away.
- **Group chat HITL** unchanged — buttons attached for C2C only.
- **Markdown→plain fallback**: when rich rendering is unavailable, falls back to plain text with an appended `Reply: 1=Approve, …` hint.

Requires the new `interaction` intent — onboarding wizard adds it automatically for new installs.

---

### 🧠 New Provider — `dashscope-code` (Alibaba Bailian Coding Plan)

Alibaba Cloud Bailian's **Coding Plan** subscription keys (`sk-sp-*`) are rejected by the standard `dashscope` endpoint and only work against `https://coding.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1`. v0.1.1 adds a sibling `dashscope-code` provider that reuses `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` but routes to the coding endpoint (#225 by @din0s, closes #224).

- **Standard `dashscope` (`sk-*`) users**: no behavior change.
- **Follows existing `zhipu` / `zhipu-code` and `moonshot` / `kimi-coding` precedent** — sibling provider entry rather than prefix-based magic, so the routing decision lives in config and is easy to inspect and override.
- **Extended model coverage** — code-oriented Qwen variants now route correctly: `qwen3-coder`, `qwen3-max`, `qwen3.5-plus`.
- Onboarding wizard recognises Coding Plan keys and validates them against the coding endpoint.

---

### 📎 `@file` Mentions — Spaces in Paths

Typing `@PREPING_ Building Agent Memory.pdf` no longer yields `file not found: PREPING_`. The parser previously truncated at the first space; now it walks across whitespace until an existing file resolves (#234 by @MuXinCG2004).

- **Greedy fallback** — extends across whitespace, bounded by newlines, the next `@`, and a 20-token cap. Strips trailing punctuation (`,;:!?)]}>`), so `@my notes.md, ...` works.
- **Explicit quoted form** — `@"path with spaces.pdf"` or `@'...'` for cases where greedy resolution shouldn't apply.
- **Autocomplete** — returns `@"..."` for any candidate containing a space, and keeps suggesting while the user types inside an unclosed `@"…`.
- 12 new test cases covering quoted forms, greedy expansion, boundary-stop at `@` / newline, trailing-punct strip, and completion quoting.

---

### 📦 Dependency Bumps

- `deepagents` `0.5.7` → `0.6.2` (with `[quickjs]` extra) — pulls langchain 1.3, langgraph 1.2, langchain-quickjs 0.1.2. See "deepagents 0.6.2 + DeltaChannel" above.
- `langchain-core` bumped in the uv group (#219, Dependabot).
- `urllib3` bumped in the uv group (#222, Dependabot).

---

## What's Changed
* chore(deps): bump langchain-core from 1.3.2 to 1.3.3 in the uv group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/219
* Feat/qq interactive buttons by @MuXinCG2004 in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/220
* chore(deps): bump urllib3 from 2.6.3 to 2.7.0 in the uv group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/222
* feat(llm): add dashscope-code provider for Alibaba Coding Plan keys by @din0s in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/225
* feat: status and elapsed time indicator by @mooshroom4422 in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/218
* fix(cli): handle spaces in @file mentions by @MuXinCG2004 in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/234
* feat(backends): implement tier-aware virtual mount resolution for ski… by @X-iZhang in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/236
* feat(middleware): upgrade deepagents 0.5.7 → 0.6.2 by @X-iZhang in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/231


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1

# EvoScientist v0.1.0 — Async Sub-Agents, Official Docker Image, Personal WeChat & Sessions DB Compaction

G'Day! v0.1.0 is the biggest release since launch. The headline is **async sub-agents** — `writing-agent` and `data-analysis-agent` now run on a managed `langgraph dev` subprocess, so 30-180s long-runners no longer block your chat, and you get **proactive completion notifications** without polling. We also ship an **official multi-arch Docker image**, a **personal-WeChat (iLink) channel backend** with QR login, the new **`/model-fallback`** command, a **`PruningCheckpointer`** that compacts multi-GB legacy `sessions.db` files in place, and a critical **HITL fix** that unblocks parallel sub-agents calling `execute`.

---

### 🚀 Async Sub-Agents (default-on)

`writing-agent` and `data-analysis-agent` typically run 30-180s. With sync delegation, your main chat was blocked the whole time. v0.1.0 transparently deploys the main agent and any sub-agent flagged `async: true` onto an auto-managed `langgraph dev` subprocess; the supervisor returns immediately with a `task_id` and keeps talking (#200).

- **Single source of truth** — per-agent YAML in `EvoScientist/subagents/` (replaces the monolithic `subagent.yaml`); both the in-process sync path and the deployed async path read from the same file. Adding a new async sub-agent: flip `async: true`, add a binding in `langgraph_dev/graphs.py`, register in `langgraph_dev/langgraph.json`.
- **Auto-managed subprocess** — `langgraph_dev/manager.py` handles start / health-check / stop. Uses `filelock` to serialize concurrent CLI invocations and `psutil` to detect stale PID files. Default port `6174` (Kaprekar's constant); onboarding has a "LangGraph Port" step that rejects already-occupied ports unless reused by EvoSci itself.
- **Workspace sync widget** — `cli/widgets/workspace_sync_widget.py` shows live progress when CLI workspace files sync to the langgraph dev subprocess.
- **Graceful fallback** — if `langgraph dev` fails to start, async sub-agents fall back to in-process synchronous delegation transparently.
- **Toggle** — set `enable_async_subagents: false` in `~/.config/evoscientist/config.yaml` to keep everything sync.

---

### 🔔 Async Sub-Agent Auto-Notifications

The main agent now learns about async completions automatically — no more "check status" polling (#214).

```
╭── ✦ Agent Teams ✦ ──────────────────╮
│ ✔ writing-agent       success       │
│ ✗ data-analysis-agent error         │
╰─────────────────────────────────────╯
```

- **Watcher pattern** — every async launch spawns a background `asyncio` task subscribed to `client.runs.join_stream(thread_id, run_id)` (SDK-native SSE long-poll). Terminal state pushes an `AsyncTaskNotification` onto a thread-safe queue; CLI / TUI / serve poll loops drain, dedup, batch, and inject as a synthetic `HumanMessage` to wake the supervisor.
- **Token-efficient** — LLM input gets compact JSON per task line (`{"agent": ..., "status": ..., "task_id": ...}`); the decorative frame with colored ✔/✗/⚠ icons lives in a separate render path.
- **Update support** — `update_async_task` (continuing a conversation with a sub-agent) creates a new `run_id` on the same `thread_id`. `_watcher_by_thread` dict + replace semantics ensure the new watcher takes over; old watcher cancelled before the new run is awaited (no stale "success" race).
- **Per-thread routing** — notifications are scoped to their originating CLI thread, so `/new` between sub-agent launch and completion no longer injects updates into the wrong thread.
- **False-positive watcher fix** — production-observed bug where the SSE long-poll closed cleanly while the run was still alive on the server (httpx timeout, HTTP/2 GOAWAY, proxy idle keep-alive) caused fake `✅ success` notifications. Watcher now uses a bounded reconnect loop and verifies via `runs.get` after every clean close (#216).
- **`/model` propagation** — `/model` switches now reach async sub-agents via `RunnableConfig.configurable`. Previously the deployed graphs froze the boot-time model, so async agents kept the old one forever (#217).

---

### 🐳 Official Docker Image

Multi-arch (`amd64` / `arm64`) image at `ghcr.io/evoscientist/evoscientist`, built via GitHub Actions (#198 by @din0s, closes #175).

```bash
docker run -it --rm \
  -v evosci-data:/home/evosci/.evoscientist \
  -v $(pwd)/workspace:/workspace \
  ghcr.io/evoscientist/evoscientist
```

- **Multi-stage build** off `python:3.11-slim-bookworm`, **uv**-managed venv with the `all-channels` extra installed via `uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-editable`.
- **Node.js 24 LTS** (copied from `node:24-bookworm-slim`) so `npx` works for the majority of MCP servers.
- **`uv` binary** so the MCP registry can install Python MCP servers on demand at runtime.
- **One-volume persistence** — `/home/evosci/.evoscientist` holds sessions DB, global skills, memories, **and** config (XDG_CONFIG_HOME points inside it; `UV_TOOL_DIR` / `UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR` redirect uv-tool artifacts there too). MCP servers installed during onboarding survive `docker run --rm`.
- **Non-root user** `evosci` for shell sandboxing.
- See the README's Docker section for derivation recipes for unbundled extras (`stt`, `oauth`, TinyTeX) and proxy / cert handling.

---

### 💬 Personal WeChat (iLink) Channel Backend

A third WeChat backend — `personal` — rides Tencent's iLink Bot long-poll gateway, letting a personal WeChat account act as a bot alongside the existing WeCom and Official Account backends (#212 by @MuXinCG2004).

- **No app-id / secret** — credentials come from a QR-code scan (`python -m EvoScientist.channels.wechat.serve --qr-login`) and are persisted under `DATA_DIR/wechat_personal/accounts/`. The wizard can drive the QR scan inline.
- **Backend picker in onboard** — first-time users pick *WeCom / 微信公众号 / 个人微信* without leaving the wizard.
- **Group delivery is opt-in** and disabled by default — iLink rarely delivers group messages for QR-login bot identities.
- **AES-128-ECB CDN media** protocol against `novac2c.cdn.weixin.qq.com`.
- New deps: `qrcode>=7.4` and `certifi>=2024.0` added to the `wechat` and `all-channels` extras.

**Why personal vs the existing backends**: WeCom and Official Account both require a registered organisation / app and issue stable credentials — fine for production bots, awkward for hobbyists. The iLink personal backend lowers that barrier: scan a QR with a personal WeChat, get a session token, run the bot.

---

### 📱 QQ Bot QR-Code Onboarding

The config wizard can now auto-fill `qq_app_id` and `qq_app_secret` after the developer scans a QR code with a bound QQ account — no more manually copying credentials from `q.qq.com` (#213 by @MuXinCG2004).

- **`qr_register()` flow** drives `q.qq.com`'s `create_bind_task` / `poll_bind_result` APIs.
- **AES-256-GCM** with a client-generated key — the bot's `client_secret` never travels in plaintext.
- **Manual fallback** on scan failure / cancel — no behavior change for users who'd rather paste credentials.
- The bot must already be registered at `q.qq.com`; scanning binds your QQ account to the existing app.

---

### 🔄 `/model-fallback` Command

A new `/model-fallback` command (#196 by @mooshroom4422, closes #67) appends a model to the session-level fallback chain. If the primary model errors out (rate limit, transient 5xx, etc.), EvoSci automatically retries with the next model in the chain.

- **Same picker as `/model`** — pick fallback models from any registered provider.
- **`/model-fallback save`** persists the chain to `~/.config/evoscientist/config.yaml`.
- **`/model-fallback help`** lists all sub-commands (add / remove / list / save).
- **Real-time status messages** during fallback attempts.

---

### 🗜️ PruningCheckpointer — Multi-GB `sessions.db` Compaction

LangGraph's `AsyncSqliteSaver` writes a full state snapshot per super-step. EvoScientist's resume / HITL / sub-agent paths only ever read the **latest** checkpoint per `(thread_id, checkpoint_ns)`, so every intermediate snapshot is dead weight. Real-world observed: a single user's `sessions.db` grew to **2.6 GB** with **8,337 checkpoints** across 153 threads — one thread alone held 1,086 checkpoints (#194).

- **Automatic per-write pruning** — `PruningCheckpointer` (subclass of `AsyncSqliteSaver`) overrides `aput()` to retain at most `checkpoint_keep_per_thread` (default `10`) rows per `(thread_id, checkpoint_ns)`. Outer `asyncio.Lock` makes `super().aput()` + prune atomic; just-written row is always kept under concurrent writers.
- **One-time migration sweep** — gated by `PRAGMA user_version` and a 100 MB size threshold. Prunes every existing `(thread, ns)` pair to N, schedules `VACUUM` via `atexit`. Live progress bar with ETA:
  ```
  · Compacting sessions DB (14.53 GB, 99 thread-namespace pairs, est. ~2m 15s)
  ⠹ Compacting 27% (27/99 pairs · 38s elapsed · ~1m 41s remaining)
  · ✓ Compaction done in 2m 18s
  ```
- **Safe across providers** — filters by `metadata.agent_name` so co-located non-EvoSci agents are never touched.
- **Race fix** (#195) — sweep now runs synchronously inside `get_checkpointer()` *before* yielding the saver, so concurrent channel `aput()`s no longer race the sweep for SQLite's EXCLUSIVE lock and trigger `Error: database is locked`.
- **Diagnostic** — new `EvoSci sessions stats` CLI command surfaces DB state.

---

### 🛡️ HITL Fix — Parallel Sub-Agents No Longer Crash

When the main agent dispatched 2+ parallel sub-agents (via `task`) that each called `execute`, LangGraph used to raise:

> When there are multiple pending interrupts, you must specify the interrupt id when resuming.

**Root cause**: DeepAgents 0.5.5 propagated the top-level `interrupt_on={"execute": True}` we passed to `create_deep_agent(...)` into every declarative sub-agent **and** the auto-injected `general-purpose` sub-agent. Parallel sub-agents then produced multiple pending interrupts in the same checkpoint, which a single resume decision could not disambiguate.

**Fix** (#202): stop passing `interrupt_on=` to `create_deep_agent`. Instead, append `HumanInTheLoopMiddleware` directly to the main agent's stack in both `_get_default_agent()` and `create_cli_agent()`. Sub-agent shell commands remain protected by `CustomSandboxBackend` static checks (blocks `sudo` / `chmod` / `dd` / path traversal, 300s timeout, 100KB cap). Semantic model: user authorizes the high-level `task` goal → sub-agent executes within sandbox limits.

---

### 🪟 Context Window Patch Table

A small per-model context-window patch table (`llm/context_window.py`) for the newest models that LangChain provider packages haven't registered profile data for yet — `claude-opus-4-7` (1M), `gpt-5.5` (1.05M), `kimi-k2.6` (262K), `deepseek-v4-pro` (1.05M), `qwen3.6-flash` (1M), `mimo-v2.5` (1.05M), `glm-5` (203K) (#191).

Without this, three things were broken for those models:

1. **Status bar percentage** showed `<used>/200K` instead of the real `<used>/1M` (the only fallback was `DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW_FALLBACK = 200_000`).
2. **deepagents `SummarizationMiddleware`** triggered way too early — its hardcoded `170K tokens` fallback meant a 1M-context model summarized at ~17% instead of ~85%.
3. **`ContextEditingMiddleware`** clear-tool-uses trigger fell back to a fixed 100K, similarly pessimistic.

The table is meant to be **trimmed over time** — once an entry shows up upstream in `sst/models.dev`, the corresponding row can be removed (the profile-reading layer wins automatically).

---

### 🔧 DeepSeek Cross-Provider Reasoning Fix

Fixes a 400 from DeepSeek V4 Pro thinking mode (`deepseek-chat`) when the conversation history contains assistant messages from another provider, from DeepSeek Flash, or from a session that predates the v0.0.9 `reasoning_content` capture patch (#192).

**Trigger scenarios** (any one is enough to break):
- User chats with Anthropic / OpenAI for a few turns, then switches to DeepSeek V4 Pro
- `/resume` of a thread previously driven by a non-thinking model
- Resuming a thread created on an older EvoSci version

**Fix**: drop the `is_reasoner` gate in `_patch_deepseek_reasoning_passback`. Empty-string fallback now applies to every assistant message that lacks `reasoning_content`, regardless of which DeepSeek model is making the call. Safe because the patch is mounted only when `provider == "deepseek"`, so all callers are guaranteed DeepSeek endpoints.

---

### 🧹 Refactors & Cleanup

- **`ChannelRuntime` replaces `cli/channel.py` module globals** (#197 by @din0s, closes #182). `_cli_agent` / `_cli_thread_id` were poked directly by `/model`, `/channel`, `_auto_start_channel`, and the Rich/TUI session loops; tests needed `_reset_channel_globals` autouse fixtures to keep state from leaking. Now: a single `ChannelRuntime()` per session, threaded through `CommandContext`. `/model` rebinds via `ctx.channel_runtime.agent = new_agent`. Behavior unchanged.
- **Skill install manifest** (#199 by @din0s). Onboarding's "install skills" step kept showing already-installed skills as still-installable. `skills_manager` now writes a per-tier `.installed.yaml` sidecar mapping installed dir name → original install source (URL, shorthand, or local path). `_step_skills` checks **both** the workspace and global tiers AND the manifest, so packs that explode into many child dirs (e.g. `EvoScientist/EvoSkills@skills` → `paper-writing/`, `evo-memory/`, …) are correctly detected.
- **Dead `MessageBus.dispatch_outbound` removed** (#205 by @MuXinCG2004). Two implementations shared the same `bus.outbound` queue: `MessageBus.dispatch_outbound` (subscriber-based) and `ChannelManager._dispatch_outbound` (registry lookup). Only the latter was wired up in production — the former was a footgun for anyone reading `MessageBus` in isolation. Net change: **+14 / −139** across 3 files. No behavior change.
- **Markdown ATX heading spacing** (#201) — ensure proper spacing for ATX headings in Markdown rendering so streaming output renders correctly.

---

### 📦 Dependency Bumps

- `deepagents` `0.5.5` → `0.5.7` (#211)

# EvoScientist v0.0.9 — Faster Startup, In-Session Model Switching, Unified CLI Commands & DeepSeek V4 Thinking Fix

G'Day! v0.0.9 focuses on **interactive UX polish and developer ergonomics**. Startup latency drops ~7×, the new **`/model` command** lets you switch models without restarting, **`--resume`** brings session resumption to first-class status, and Rich CLI / TUI / Channels now share a unified slash-command pipeline. We also ship a critical **DeepSeek V4 thinking-mode fix**, MCP reliability improvements behind proxies, and broader frontier model coverage (GPT 5.5 / 5.5-pro, DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash, Kimi K2.6, MiMo V2.5).

---

### ⚡ Startup Latency: ~2.2s → ~0.3s

`evosci --help / config / ...` now launches in a fraction of the time. Heavy imports (`langchain.chat_models`, `langgraph`, `textual`, `prompt_toolkit`) were previously loaded on every invocation; they're now deferred via PEP 562 `__getattr__` / `lazy_loader.attach` so they only load when the active path needs them. Interactive launch no longer blocks on MCP — agent construction runs in a background thread, the banner and prompt render immediately, and tools attach as they become ready (#171 by @din0s). Adds `lazy-loader>=0.5`.

---

### 🔄 `/model` — In-Session Model Switching

A new `/model` slash command lets you switch chat models without restarting (#162 by @mooshroom4422).

- **Interactive picker** in TUI (browse all registered models grouped by provider)
- **Direct invocation**: `/model gpt-5.5 openai`, `/model claude-opus-4-7`
- **`--save` flag** for persistent changes to `~/.config/evoscientist/config.yaml`
- **Off-by-one fix**: previously the picker applied the *previously* selected model — now applies the just-chosen one (#180)
- **Ollama first-class support** — picker probes `GET {ollama_base_url}/api/tags` (1.5s timeout) and lists locally-pulled models live; no more `Unknown model` errors for Ollama entries (#187)

---

### 🔁 Session Resumption (`--resume`)

`--resume <id|prefix>` is now a first-class flag, working uniformly across interactive, single-shot (`-p`), and TUI modes (#170).

- Aliased to `--thread-id`, listed first in `--help` for discoverability
- **Prefix-based thread ID resolution** — type just the first few chars
- **On-exit hint** printed on every exit path (`/exit`, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D):
  ```
  Goodbye!

  Resume this session with:
  EvoSci --resume <thread_id>
  ```
- New helper `sessions.resolve_thread_id_prefix()` — single source of truth for prefix → full-ID resolution

---

### 🧩 Unified CLI Slash-Command Pipeline

Rich CLI now dispatches slash commands through the same `CommandManager` + `Command` architecture that TUI and Channels already used (#178, closes #63). Eliminates duplicated inline `if user_input.lower() == "/xxx":` branches scattered across `_async_main_loop`. Every command now has **one implementation, three surfaces**.

- **Channel-originated slash commands fix** — `/evoskills`, `/channel status`, `/mcp list`, etc. are no longer silently passed to the LLM as plain prompts when `ui_backend=rich` or `EvoSci serve`. New shared helper `dispatch_channel_slash_command` wires Rich CLI and headless serve through the same dispatch path as TUI (#184, closes #181)

---

### 🧠 DeepSeek V4 Thinking Mode — Multi-Turn Fix

DeepSeek V4 thinking mode previously failed with `400` on every multi-turn + tool-use conversation: `"The reasoning_content in the thinking mode must be passed back to the API."` (#190).

**Root cause**: DeepSeek V4 requires a top-level `reasoning_content` field on every historical assistant message. `langchain-openai`'s default `_convert_dict_to_message` / `_convert_message_to_dict` ignored this field on both capture and replay.

**Fix**: two surgical patches in `llm/patches.py`:
- `_patch_openai_capture_reasoning_content()` — module-level monkey-patch capturing `reasoning_content` from response into `AIMessage.additional_kwargs` (benign for non-DeepSeek providers — they don't return the field)
- `_patch_deepseek_reasoning_passback()` — per-instance, mounts only when `provider=deepseek`, injects `reasoning_content` back into outgoing payload (mirrors langchain-ai/langchain PR #34516)

---

### 📋 System Prompt Refactor

Splits the 222-line `EXPERIMENT_WORKFLOW` constant into 6 focused constants — `EVOSCIENTIST_IDENTITY`, `EXPERIMENT_WORKFLOW`, `REPORT_TEMPLATE`, `WRITING_GUIDELINES`, `SHELL_GUIDELINES`, `DELEGATION_STRATEGY` — and removes inline content duplication (Step 5 now references `REPORT_TEMPLATE`). Also fixes a silent memory-path bug. (#189)

---

### 🤖 New Model Support

Frontier models registered across native providers, OpenRouter, and custom-OpenAI endpoints (#188):

| Family | Models | Providers |
|---|---|---|
| **OpenAI GPT 5.5** | `gpt-5.5`, `gpt-5.5-pro` | native OpenAI, custom-openai, OpenRouter (`openai/gpt-5.5-pro`) |
| **DeepSeek V4** | `deepseek-v4-pro`, `deepseek-v4-flash` | native DeepSeek, OpenRouter |
| **Moonshot Kimi K2.6** | `kimi-k2.6` | native Moonshot, OpenRouter (`moonshotai/kimi-k2.6`) |
| **Xiaomi MiMo V2.5** | `mimo-v2.5`, `mimo-v2.5-pro` | OpenRouter (`xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro`) |

Native-OpenAI `xhigh` reasoning-effort gate extended to `gpt-5.5` (matching `gpt-5.4` / codex behavior). Legacy `deepseek-r1` / `deepseek-v3` aliases retained but deprecated 2026-07-24.

---

### 📡 MCP Reliability

Two independent fixes for stdio-based MCP servers (#169 by @din0s):

- **Proxy environment passthrough** — MCP SDK's `stdio_client` previously stripped everything outside a hardcoded allowlist (`HOME, LOGNAME, PATH, SHELL, TERM, USER`). `http_proxy` / `https_proxy` / `SSL_CERT_FILE` / `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` etc. now propagate to spawned subprocesses
- **Durable package installs** — fixes broken stdio MCP servers when EvoScientist is installed from source

---

### 🔧 Channel & Terminal Fixes

- **Channel `/stop` and `/cancel`** — scoped to the current chat session instead of process-wide stop flag; can now cancel both queued work and active responses; `/resume` in channel mode replays recent saved history (#186 by @MuXinCG2004)
- **Text copy on remote/legacy terminals** — adds simple fallback for SSH (Windows Terminal, PuTTY) clipboard handling (#185 by @mooshroom4422)
- **Clipboard copy** — removed unnecessary check for selection end in `copy_selection_to_clipboard`

---

* feat: add support for session resumption with --resume flag and enhan… by @X-iZhang in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/170
* feat: add /model command for changing models inside TUI/CLI by @mooshroom4422 in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/162
* perf(cli): cut startup latency and defer MCP loading to the background by @din0s in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/171
* Refactor/cli command manager by @X-iZhang in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/178
* fix(chat): resolve model switch lag by tracking model/provider key by @X-iZhang in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/180
* Fix/channel slash rich cli by @X-iZhang in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/184
* fix: text copy on remote sessions/legacy terminal emulators by @mooshroom4422 in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/185
* feat: add support for gpt-5.5 model in the LLM configuration and tests by @X-iZhang in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/188
* feat: Enhance ModelPickerWidget for Ollama integration by @X-iZhang in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/187
* fix(channel): scope stop and restore resume history by @MuXinCG2004 in https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/186

# EvoScientist v0.0.8 — Unified Data Directory, Status Bar, Enhanced Ask-User & Auto-Mode

G'Day! We're excited to release EvoScientist v0.0.8. This release **unifies all application data under `~/.evoscientist/`** (separating config from state per XDG spec), adds a **persistent session status bar** with real-time context window tracking, **enhances ask-user prompts** with multiple-choice and free-text validation, renames `--auto-approve` to **`--auto-mode`** for unattended execution, and ships several channel and skill management fixes.

---

### 📂 Unified Global Data Directory (`~/.evoscientist/`)

Application data files now live in `~/.evoscientist/`, separate from configuration in `~/.config/evoscientist/` — properly respecting the XDG Base Directory spec (#164).

**New layout:**

| | Path | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| Config | `~/.config/evoscientist/` | `config.yaml`, `mcp.yaml`, `latest_version.json` |
| Data | `~/.evoscientist/` (new) | `sessions.db`, `skills/`, `memories/`, `history` |

- Override with `EVOSCIENTIST_DATA_DIR` environment variable
- **`sessions.db` migrates automatically** on first startup (copies SQLite trio to new location; legacy files remain as backup; idempotent via `.migrated` marker)
- `skills/`, `memories/`, `history` are not auto-migrated — users can tell EvoSci to sync manually
- `update_check.py` now respects `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` instead of hardcoding `~/.config/evoscientist`

---

### 📊 Session Status Bar & Context Window Tracking

A persistent status bar now shows real-time context usage (tokens used / context window / %) in both CLI and TUI frontends (#152).

- **Rich CLI**: rendered via `PromptSession(bottom_toolbar=...)` — always visible below input prompt
- **Textual TUI**: live updates every second via `set_interval(1.0, _render_status)`
- Updates during streaming, after `/compact`, and on every `usage_stats` event from the LLM
- Token counts sourced from `usage_metadata.input_tokens` (real LLM input); falls back to checkpoint estimation at cold start

**Unified context window resolver** (`llm/context_window.py`): `resolve_context_window()` inspects multiple model attributes (`context_window`, `context_length`, `num_ctx`, `max_input_tokens`, container dicts) — works across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama, and custom endpoints.

**`/compact` UX improvements:**
- Threshold now uses LLM-level `display_percent` instead of message-level percent
- `context_percent` reflects **post**-compact utilization
- Status bar updates immediately after `/compact` — no need to wait for next LLM call
- New TUI widgets: `CompactingWidget` (elapsed timer), `CompactSummaryWidget` (collapsible summary panel)

---

### 💬 Enhanced Ask-User Prompts

The `ask_user` middleware now supports structured prompts with multiple-choice options, free-text validation, and an "Other" option with custom input (#161).

- Multiple-choice questions with numbered options and validation
- Free-text prompts with skip option
- `"Other"` option triggers follow-up free-text input
- Memory (`MEMORY.md`) migrated to global `~/.evoscientist/memories/` path
- `MEMORY_DIR` renamed to `MEMORIES_DIR` for consistency

---

### ⚙️ Auto-Mode & Auto-Approve Rename

`--auto-approve` is now `--auto-mode` to better reflect its purpose: fully unattended execution (#152).

- CLI flag: `EvoSci --auto-mode` / `EvoSci serve --auto-mode`
- Config key: `auto_mode: true` (replaces `auto_approve`)
- Checkpoint queries now filter by agent name for correctness

---

### 🔧 Skills & Backend Improvements

- **`MergedReadOnlyBackend` → `MergedSkillsBackend`** — clearer naming; `ensure_dirs()` simplified to eagerly create only the shared `memory/` directory; skills directories created lazily on first install (#157)
- **Skill source filtering fix** — `/skills` list now correctly includes workspace and global tiers when filtering skill sources (#159)

---

### 📡 Channel Fixes

- **QQ HITL approval delivery** — fixed silently dropped approval prompts when QQ server rejects markdown (template not configured, content audit); fresh `msg_seq` for plain-text fallback; recognizes QQ server error codes (304014/304023/304003/40034059) and CN fragments (#166 by @MuXinCG2004)

---

### 🌐 MiniMax Region Selection

Corrected the MiniMax API endpoint and added region selection support for MiniMax models (#158 by @din0s).

### 🤖 New Model Support

Added model entries for **Claude Opus 4-7** and updated version handling for the latest Anthropic model family.

- **Auto-summarization display fix** — detect `_summarization_event` from LangGraph state updates when summarization middleware uses `ainvoke` (non-streaming), emit proper `summarization` event

- **`sessions.py`** — fixed negative `cutoff_index` in `_apply_summarization_event()` silently discarding messages

# EvoScientist v0.0.7 — Global Skills Directory, Moonshot/Kimi Providers, ccproxy Fixes & Channel Improvements

G'Day! We're excited to release EvoScientist v0.0.7. This release introduces a **three-tier global skills directory** so installed skills are shared across all workspaces, adds **Moonshot and Kimi Coding Plan** as new LLM providers, fixes **ccproxy Codex OAuth compatibility** for the Responses API path, patches **OpenAI-compatible streaming content flattening**, and ships several channel reliability improvements.

---

### 🗂️ Three-Tier Global Skills Directory

Skills installed once are now available across all your workspaces — no more re-running `/install-skill` per project (#151).

**Priority** (high → low):
1. `workspace/skills/` — project-local (`--local` flag)
2. `~/.config/evoscientist/skills/` — user-global (**new default install target**, XDG-compliant)

`_patch_openai_compat_content()` previously only patched `_generate`/`_agenerate` (non-streaming), but EvoSci CLI always uses streaming paths. Extended the content-flattening patch to `_stream`/`_astream` so strict OpenAI-compatible relays receive plain string content during streaming calls (#147).

# EvoScientist v0.0.6 — Dynamic Context Management, OpenRouter Reasoning, More Effort Mode, GLM-5.1 & Telegram Fix

G'Day! We're excited to release EvoScientist v0.0.6. This release brings **Dynamic Context Management** with two new LangChain middleware (ContextEditing + Adaptive Tool Selection), an **OpenRouter streaming reasoning fix** with expanded model coverage, a **More Effort code generation mode**, **GLM-5.1 model support** for Zhipu providers, and a **Telegram channel startup fix** — along with ccproxy 0.2.7 upgrade and several quality-of-life improvements.

---

### 🧠 Dynamic Context Management — ContextEditing & Adaptive Tool Selection

Two new middleware that work together to keep long-running conversations efficient and tool routing precise (#127):

**1. ContextEditingMiddleware** — Automatically clears old tool outputs (replacing with `[cleared]`) before sending to the LLM, reducing input token costs. Triggers at **50% of model context window**, well before the existing SummarizationMiddleware (~85%). Dynamic trigger computation based on model profile, with fallback for providers without profile (OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, Ollama). Preserves the 5 most recent tool outputs and always keeps `think_tool` content (reflection is not re-obtainable).

**2. LLMToolSelectorMiddleware** — Uses the model to intelligently select only the relevant tools per query when tool count exceeds 20 (e.g., after MCP integration). Core tools (`think_tool`, `task`) are always included. Includes an adaptive **Adaptive Selected Tools** panel in the streaming display — only shows when tools are actually filtered and the selection changes.

# EvoScientist v0.0.5 — Context Retry Middleware, OpenAI Relay Config, Feishu Event Loop Fix & Compact Conversation

G'Day! We're excited to release EvoScientist v0.0.5. This release brings a **Context Overflow Retry Middleware** that auto-recovers from provider context limit errors, a **`use_responses_api` config option** for OpenAI-compatible relays, a **Feishu SDK event loop isolation fix** for Linux, and a **`/compact` thread_id injection fix** — along with onboard UX improvements and benchmark award updates.

---

### 🔄 Context Overflow Retry Middleware

A new middleware that detects provider-specific context limit errors (4xx) and maps them to a standard `ContextOverflowError`, enabling DeepAgents' `SummarizationMiddleware` to automatically summarize and retry.

- `middleware/context_overflow.py` (new) — `ContextOverflowMapperMiddleware` wraps both sync and async model calls; pattern-matches 8 common provider error messages (`context_length_exceeded`, `too many tokens`, `max_tokens_exceeded`, etc.) combined with HTTP 400 status detection
- Auto-wired in `EvoScientist.py` alongside existing middleware (Memory, AskUser)
- 112-line test suite in `tests/test_context_overflow_middleware.py`

---

### ⚙️ `use_responses_api` Config for OpenAI Relays

`langchain-openai` auto-switches to the Responses API when reasoning params are set, which breaks OpenAI-compatible relay servers that only support Chat Completions. A new user-facing config option overrides this behavior.

```bash
EvoSci config set use_responses_api false
# or env var: EVOSCIENTIST_USE_RESPONSES_API=false
```

- `config/settings.py` — new `use_responses_api` field (optional, `None` by default)
- `llm/models.py` — reads env var, forces `use_responses_api=False` and drops `reasoning` kwargs when set to `"false"`
- `apply_config_to_env()` propagates config file value to env var
- 72-line parametrized test suite covering case/whitespace normalization

---

### 🔧 Feishu SDK Event Loop Isolation (Linux Fix)

`lark_oapi.ws.client` captures the main thread's event loop at import time. On Linux/Python 3.12, the shared loop caused cross-thread `RuntimeError` and `AttributeError` when `nest_asyncio` patches interacted with the SDK thread.

- Replaced the previous `Handle._run` monkey-patch (symptom suppression) with a proper fix: creates a fresh event loop in the SDK thread and swaps the module-level loop variable
- Eliminates `RuntimeError: Leaving task … does not match the current task` and `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'select'`

---

### 🧵 `/compact` Thread ID Injection

The `/compact` command (conversation summarization) ran outside a LangGraph runnable context, causing `_get_thread_id()` to fail and generate random `session_xxx` filenames instead of reusing the real thread ID.

- `cli/commands.py` — injects `thread_id` into LangGraph's `var_child_runnable_config` contextvar before offloading history, properly cleaned up in `finally` block
- Compact history files now correctly named by thread ID

---

### 🛠️ Fixes & Improvements

- **OpenRouter key validation** — Switched from `openai.Client.models.list()` to the dedicated `/auth/key` endpoint via `httpx`, eliminating the `openai` SDK dependency for validation and providing more reliable auth checks (#110)
- **LaTeX onboard UX** — Replaced yes/no confirm with a `questionary.select` picker ("No need" / "Install now"), defaulting to skip for faster onboarding (#110)
- **Welcome banner** — Enhanced to include file commands indication in both Classic CLI and TUI (#110)
- **TUI clipboard paste** — Simplified paste behavior to remove unnecessary complexity (#96)
- **`@ file` mention deduplication** — File mentions are now deduplicated with improved warning message formatting (#96)
- **Thread selector path grouping** — Optimized ancestor grouping with improved path comparison efficiency (#96)
- **Awards & benchmarks** — Updated README with AstaBench Data Analysis #1 ranking and reorganized awards section (#111, #113)
- **Dependency bump** — `requests` updated via Dependabot

# EvoScientist v0.0.4 — @ file Mentions, Resume History, Feishu WebSocket & LaTeX Setup

G'Day! We're excited to release EvoScientist v0.0.4. This release brings **`@ file` mention support** for injecting file contents directly into messages, **conversation history display on `/resume`**, a **WebSocket subscription mode for Feishu**, and a **LaTeX environment setup step** in the onboard wizard — along with a `uv tool install` compatibility fix and a TUI slash-command completion bugfix.

---

### 📎 `@ file` Mentions — Inject File Contents into Messages

Type `@filename` in both the Classic CLI and TUI to embed file contents directly into your message before it is sent to the agent. Tab/autocomplete support is included — start typing `@` and matching files from the workspace are suggested.

- `cli/file_mentions.py` (new) — `complete_file_mention()` for autocomplete candidates, `resolve_file_mentions()` to expand `@path` tokens into inline file content (≤256 KB embedded; larger files get a path-only reference with `read_file` hint)
- **Classic CLI** — `SlashCommandCompleter` extended to handle `@` prefix; autocomplete replaces the `@token` in-place
- **TUI** — `@ file` completion integrated into the existing slash-command completion widget; two-column display (filename + type hint); `resolve_file_mentions` called before the message is dispatched to the agent
- **Tests** — `tests/test_file_mentions.py` (247 lines)

---

### 🕘 Conversation History Display on `/resume`

When resuming a thread, the last 50 human/AI messages are now displayed immediately so you can see where you left off — no more jumping back into a blank screen. Tool and system messages are filtered out. If the history exceeds 50 messages, a `── ... N earlier messages ──` header is shown.

- **Classic CLI** — new `_display_resume_history()` helper called after thread is loaded
- **TUI** — two-level thread picker (`ThreadSelector` widget) renders thread summaries grouped by workspace; history replayed on selection

---

### 🔌 Feishu WebSocket Long-Connection Mode

Feishu now supports **WebSocket** as an alternative to webhook for event subscription. This allows running EvoScientist without a public IP, port forwarding, or tunnel — ideal for local development and NAT/firewall setups.

- New `feishu_subscription_mode` config: `"webhook"` (default) or `"websocket"`
- WebSocket mode uses the official `lark-oapi` SDK with a thread-safe queue bridge
- Onboard wizard: mode selection step + SDK install prompt for websocket mode
- CLI: `--mode webhook|websocket` flag for standalone `EvoSci serve`
- Install with: `pip install 'evoscientist[feishu]'`
- 5 new tests covering config, SDK missing error, message bridge, and cleanup

---

### 📄 LaTeX Environment Setup in Onboard Wizard

A new step in `EvoSci onboard` (after MCP Servers, before Channels) sets up your LaTeX environment for the `paper-writing` skill.

- Cross-platform detection of `pdflatex`, `latexmk`, `tlmgr` with single-line status display
- Auto-detects install method per platform: curl/wget (macOS/Linux), choco/scoop (Windows)
- Auto-installs `latexmk` via `tlmgr` if TinyTeX is present but `latexmk` is missing
- 28 new tests covering all helper functions and step logic

---

### 🛠️ Fixes

**TUI slash-command completion Enter key** — PR #85 replaced `Input` with `ChatTextArea`, which broke slash-command completion: `ChatTextArea._on_key()` was intercepting Enter before the app-level handler could apply the selected completion. Fixed by adding a `before_submit` callback to `ChatTextArea`, wired to `_handle_completion_enter()` in the TUI app. Enter now correctly applies the selected completion (or auto-selects the first item if none highlighted).

**`uv tool install` compatibility** — Users who install via `uv tool install evoscientist` previously got silent failures when onboard tried to install channel dependencies or MCP servers. Two root causes fixed:
- `uv pip install` without `--python` fails in `uv tool` isolated envs. Fix: always pass `--python sys.executable`.
- Wrong error hint: `pip_install_hint()` returned `"uv pip install"`. Fix: detect uv tool env via `VIRTUAL_ENV` path, return `"uv tool install --reinstall evoscientist --with"` instead.
- MCP binary not on PATH after install: `_resolve_command_path()` now checks `Path(sys.executable).parent` and writes the absolute path to `mcp.yaml`.

---

## What's Changed

## EvoScientist v0.0.3 — Voice Input, New Providers, Smarter TUI

G'Day! We're excited to release EvoScientist v0.0.3. This release adds **voice transcription** across all messaging channels, two new first-class LLM providers (**MiniMax** and **DeepSeek**), an **MCP server browser**, a **skill browser** with tag-based filtering, and a major round of TUI/CLI UX polish — multi-line input, timestamps, update notifications, and more — making EvoScientist more natural to talk to, easier to extend, and smoother to use day-to-day.

---

### 🎙️ Voice Transcription (STT) for All Channels

All 10 messaging channels now support **speech-to-text** — send a voice message via Telegram, WeChat, Feishu, or any other surface, and EvoScientist transcribes it before processing. Powered by [faster-whisper](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper) with auto language detection (Chinese, English, or auto).

- Configurable via `stt_enabled`, `stt_language`, `stt_model`, `stt_device`, `stt_compute_type`
- Install with: `pip install 'EvoScientist[stt]'`

---

### 🧠 New Models & Providers

Two new first-class providers with full onboarding wizard support (API key validation, model selection):

| Provider | Models |
|----------|--------|
| **MiniMax** | M2.7, M2.7-highspeed, M2.5, M2.5-highspeed — via Anthropic-compatible routing with extended thinking support |
| **DeepSeek** | DeepSeek-R1 (reasoner), DeepSeek-V3 (chat) — with sequence content fix for reliable streaming |
| OpenAI | GPT-5.4 Mini, GPT-5.4 Nano |
| Volcengine | Doubao Seed 2.0 Pro / Lite / Mini / Code |

Tavily search tool now loads conditionally — no `TAVILY_API_KEY` required to start EvoScientist.

---

### 🖥️ TUI & CLI Improvements

- **Multi-line input** — Shift+Enter for newlines; Enter to send. Natural multi-line editing in the chat input box
- **Timestamps** — every message now shows when it was sent
- **Update check** — EvoSci checks PyPI on startup and notifies you when a new version is available (cached, non-blocking)
- **Double Ctrl+C quit** — first press interrupts the agent, second press confirms exit (no more accidental quits)
- **Arrow key navigation** — up/down keys now work correctly in input prompts and selection widgets
- **TAB key fix** — cursor no longer disappears after pressing Tab in the text box
- **Clipboard read** — read text from system clipboard into the agent context
- **Command module refactor** — slash commands extracted from TUI into a standalone `commands/` module with `CommandManager`, shared between CLI, TUI, and channel surfaces
- **Discord message length** — adjusted max message length to 2000 (the actual Discord limit)

---

### 🔌 `/evoskills` Skill Browser & `/mcp browse` MCP Browser

- **`/evoskills`** (renamed from `/install-skills`) — browse and install skills from the EvoSkills repository with **tag-based filtering**. Full interactive TUI widget with search, tag filter, and batch install
- **`/mcp browse`** — browse and install community MCP servers directly from the CLI. Discover servers, preview their tools, and install with a single command — no more manually editing `mcp.yaml`

---

### 🔒 Sandbox Security Hardening

- **Absolute system path detection** — shell commands containing absolute paths like `/Users/foo/file` or paths inside quoted strings (`python -c "os.remove('/etc/...')"`) are now blocked. All file operations must use relative paths within the workspace
- **Executable position awareness** — the validator now distinguishes between command-position paths (e.g., `/usr/bin/python`) and operand-position paths, reducing false positives
- **Validation order fix** — command validation now runs *after* path sanitization (workspace-root prefix stripping), preventing bypasses

---

### 🛠️ Fixes & Infrastructure

- **Sub-agent summarization** — fixed summarize behavior for long sub-agent conversations
- **DeepSeek streaming** — fixed sequence content error where list-of-blocks content in assistant messages caused API rejection
- **Dotenv centralized** — `.env` loading moved into `get_effective_config()` for consistent behavior across all entry points
- **MCP config dedup** — eliminated duplicate config loading during MCP startup (`load_mcp_config` now called once per cache miss, not twice)

- **System prompt date** — dynamic date injection (`{date}` template) so the agent always knows today's date
- **Windows onboarding** — `npx` detection now finds `.cmd` / `.bat` wrappers on Windows
- **Ruff linting** — full codebase lint + formatting rules enabled with pre-commit hooks; all existing violations resolved

## EvoScientist v0.0.2 — OAuth, Human-in-the-Loop, and a Smarter TUI

We're excited to release EvoScientist v0.0.2. This release deepens the **human-on-the-loop** philosophy with OAuth authentication, richer human-agent interaction primitives, a headless serve mode, and substantial TUI polish — making EvoScientist more accessible, more interactive, and deployable across a wider range of environments.

---

### 🔑 OAuth Support — No API Key Required

EvoScientist now supports OAuth authentication for both **Claude Pro/Max** (Anthropic) and **ChatGPT Plus/Pro** (OpenAI), powered by [ccproxy](https://github.com/CaddyGlow/ccproxy-api). Subscribers can run the full research pipeline without managing API keys.

- `anthropic_auth_mode: oauth` — authenticate with your Claude subscription
- `openai_auth_mode: oauth` — authenticate with your ChatGPT subscription
- ccproxy is auto-started and stopped by the CLI — no manual process management needed
- The onboarding wizard walks you through both auth modes interactively

---

### 🤝 Human-in-the-Loop & `ask_user`

Two complementary interaction primitives give researchers meaningful control checkpoints:

- **HITL Action Approval** — the agent pauses before executing shell commands; approve, reject, or "approve all" for the session. Works across Rich CLI, TUI, and channel surfaces. Configurable `shell_allow_list` for auto-approving trusted commands.
- **`ask_user` tool** — the agent proactively asks clarifying questions when it encounters ambiguity: *"Which dataset — CIFAR-10 or ImageNet?"*, *"PyTorch or JAX?"*. Interactive widgets in both CLI and TUI; channel-aware (sends prompt via message bus).

---

### 🚀 Headless Serve Mode

```bash
EvoSci serve                   # poll channel queue, process via agent
EvoSci serve --auto-approve    # skip HITL prompts
EvoSci serve --no-thinking     # disable thinking relay
```

Deploy EvoScientist as a headless daemon — channels only, no interactive prompt. Designed for server environments where researchers interact via Telegram, Slack, Feishu, or other surfaces.

---

### 🖥️ TUI & CLI Improvements

- **`/compact`** — summarize conversation history to free context while preserving key findings
- **Thread Picker** — inline thread selection widget for switching sessions without leaving the TUI
- **Streaming Final Frame** — all tool calls expand in a clean, persistent final frame after generation; no flash-then-dump
- **Unified Diff Display** — `edit_file` results shown as readable unified diffs
- **Token Usage** — per-turn `[Usage: X in · Y out]` display in both CLI and TUI, styled in cyan/green
- **History Auto-Suggest** — TUI input completes from command history
- **Timeout Recovery** — shell timeouts now emit actionable guidance (background execution, log tailing, workload reduction) instead of a bare exit code 124

---

# EvoScientist v0.0.1 — First Release of the Self-Evolving AI Scientist

We're excited to announce the first public release of **EvoScientist** — a multi-agent AI system for automated scientific experimentation and discovery. 🔬🚀

EvoScientist moves beyond traditional human-in-the-loop systems, adopting a **human-on-the-loop** paradigm where AI acts as a research buddy that co-evolves with human researchers and internalizes scholarly taste and scientific judgment.

---

## ✨ What's Included

- 🤖 **Multi-Agent Team** — 6 specialized sub-agents (Planner, Researcher, Coder, Debugger, Analyst, Writer) orchestrated by DeepAgents + LangGraph
- 🧠 **Persistent Memory** — Context, findings, and scholarly taste survive across sessions
- 🌐 **7 LLM Providers** — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google GenAI, NVIDIA, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter, Ollama — one config to switch between them all
- 📱 **10 Channels** — CLI as the hub; Telegram, Slack, Feishu, WeChat, iMessage and more — one agent, every surface
- 🔬 **Scientific Workflow** — Intake → Plan → Execute → Evaluate → Write → Verify
- 🔌 **MCP & Skills** — Plug in MCP servers or install skills from GitHub on the fly
- 🧬 **EvoSkills Ecosystem** — 10 research-lifecycle skills covering the full pipeline: ideation → experimentation → writing → memory

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

```bash
pip install EvoScientist
EvoSci onboard
EvoSci
```

---

**Human on the loop. AI in the lab. Science that evolves.** 🔄
